notes: Use it after changing anything that remaps keys. Before you start: Mapping → A → B, then Mapping → B → A. Afterwards: Mapping → Reset all remaps (an A/B swap left on breaks games). Pressing A must show B on the pad and pressing B must show A. The expectations are written out in the template on purpose, so it does not check the mapper against itself. Runs on the App path and then on Driver LIVE.

steps.detail: Put the controller down and let go of every stick, trigger and button. The pad has to stay completely still.
steps.title: Hands off everything

steps.detail: Press A, let go, press it again, let go. With A and B swapped the pad shows B.
steps.title: Press A twice

steps.detail: Press B, let go, press it again, let go. With A and B swapped the pad shows A.
steps.title: Press B twice

title: Remap check: A and B swapped (App, then Driver)
